name: ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson
short_description: A 298-room hotel atop Macpherson Mall with a 25-metre freeform pool and tropical-resort facade, roughly 1km from Tai Seng/Mattar MRT.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson is a 298-room hotel at the corner of Macpherson and Aljunied Road, occupying levels 4 to 9 above Macpherson Mall in a mostly residential stretch of eastern Singapore. Opened in April 2016, it's built around a distinctive cruise-ship-style facade and a 25-metre freeform outdoor pool set in a landscaped, tropical-resort-style courtyard, with a gym overlooking both the pool and MacPherson Road. It sits roughly 1km (about a 15-minute walk) from Tai Seng/Mattar MRT, and the hotel runs a free shuttle to nearby MRT stations to bridge the gap. Guests consistently single out the pool and friendly, attentive staff as highlights, while reviews note the rooms and lifts can feel tight and the breakfast area gets crowded at peak times.

faqs.question: How do I get to ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson from the MRT?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits about 1km, roughly a 15-minute walk, from Tai Seng/Mattar MRT stations. To make up for the distance, the hotel runs a complimentary shuttle bus service to nearby MRT stations, which most guests use rather than walking, especially with luggage or in Singapore's heat and humidity.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, it has a 25-metre freeform outdoor pool set in a landscaped, tropical-resort-style courtyard on level 4, widely regarded as the hotel's standout feature. There's also a gym overlooking the pool and MacPherson Road, and a poolside cafe and bar for guests to relax at afterward.

reviews.title: ibis Styles Singapore on MacPherson: Review & Video
reviews.summary: A Singapore blogger praises the space-efficient room design, the 25m freeform pool with cabanas, and included breakfast, but notes no room service, no wardrobe, and no bathrobe or slippers.
